Incredible opportunity, a 3 bedroom flat with terrace and private garden plus garage in São Martinho do Bispo meters from the Agrarian school!

 

In the social area it consists of a fully equipped kitchen, with direct access to a balcony and the private terrace, ideal for enjoying moments of leisure outdoors. The kitchen also has a practical pantry. The living room, large and bright, also benefits from access to a second balcony, providing greater spaciousness and connection to the outside.

In the private area, the flat has a suite, a full bathroom with shower and two bedrooms, one of which has a built-in wardrobe, ensuring greater storage capacity. 

Due to its characteristics and location, it is an excellent option for both own housing and investment. Also noteworthy is its history of renting to students, in an area with high housing demand.

The flat is sold fully furnished, allowing an immediate entry into the rental market and a quick monetisation.

In a privileged area due to its proximity to university centres, pharmacies, cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, hospitals and health centre, bank, among others. This property benefits from excellent access, proximity to the main roads and the motorway, as well as several public transport lines.
